comment: ANCHOR: BUILD_HERMES_CANONICAL_STATUS_COUNTS_20261107 — LQ-20261107-139. The canonical snapshot that the
portal, the matrix Markdown and the Word doc are regenerated from carried crons_count 209 / timers_count 38
as literals from 2026-06-07 against a host with 327 active crontab lines and 83 user timers. The two are
measured now, with the definition written beside them, and a host that cannot be asked yields null with the
reason instead of a remembered number or a zero. Listing it schedules nothing.
